component.name: julIDE
component.summary: A modern IDE for the Julia programming language

description.p: julIDE is a desktop IDE for Julia. It pairs a Monaco-based editor with language intelligence from LanguageServer.jl, an integrated REPL, and a debugger, so an entire Julia workflow fits in one window.

ul.li: Monaco editor with Julia syntax highlighting, snippets, and LaTeX-to-Unicode input
Autocompletion, hover docs, go-to-definition, and inline diagnostics via LanguageServer.jl
Interactive REPL with full PTY emulation and multiple terminal sessions
Step-through debugging with breakpoints and variable inspection via Debugger.jl
Inline plots and rich output — PNG, SVG, and HTML
Code cells: run a block with Ctrl+Enter and see the result inline
Variable explorer, package manager, and environment switching
Git integration via libgit2, with GitHub, GitLab, and Gitea support
Dev container support for Docker and Podman

description.p: Julia itself is not bundled and must be installed separately.
Beta releases. See the GitHub releases page for details.
